sections.label: Book 3
sections.name: The sacred fires, Agnihotra and the Four-monthly rites

verses.sa: समिधाऽग्निं दुवस्यत घृतैर्बोधयतातिथिम्। आस्मिन् हव्या जुहोतन॥
verses.tr: samidhā'gniṃ duvasyata ghṛtairbodhayatātithim āsmin havyā juhotana
verses.en: Serve Agni with the kindling-brand, with drops of butter wake the Guest. In him pay offerings to the Gods.

verses.sa: सुसमिद्धाय शोचिषे घृतं तीव्रं जुहोतन। अग्नये जातवेदसे॥
verses.tr: susamiddhāya śociṣe ghṛtaṃ tīvraṃ juhotana agnaye jātavedase
verses.en: To Agni Jatavedas, to the flame, the well-enkindled God, Offer thick sacrificial oil.

verses.sa: तं त्वा समिद्भिरङ्गिरो घृतेन वर्धयामसि। बृहच्छोचा यविष्ठ्य॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā samidbhiraṅgiro ghṛtena vardhayāmasi bṛhacchocā yaviṣṭhya
verses.en: Thee, such, O Angiras, with brands and sacred oil we magnify, O very brilliant, Youthfullest.

verses.sa: उप त्वाऽग्ने हविष्मतीर्घृताचीर्यन्तु हर्यत। जुषस्व समिधो मम॥
verses.tr: upa tvā'gne haviṣmatīrghṛtācīryantu haryata juṣasva samidho mama
verses.en: Rich in oblations, dropping oil, to thee, sweet Agni, let them go. Accept with favour these my brands.

verses.sa: भूर्भुवः स्वर्द्यौरिव भूम्ना पृथिवीव वरिम्णा। तस्यास्ते पृथिवि देवयजनि पृष्ठेऽग्निमन्नादमन्नाद्यायादधे॥
verses.tr: bhūrbhuvaḥ svardyauriva bhūmnā pṛthivīva varimṇā tasyāste pṛthivi devayajani pṛṣṭhe'gnimannādamannādyāyādadhe
verses.en: Earth! Ether! Sky! Like heaven in plenty and like earth in compass! Upon thy back, Earth, place of sacrificing to Gods, for gain of food I lay food-eating Agni.

verses.sa: आयं गौः पृश्निरक्रमीदसदन् मातरं पुरः। पितरं च प्रयन्त्स्वः॥
verses.tr: āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnirakramīdasadan mātaraṃ puraḥ pitaraṃ ca prayantsvaḥ
verses.en: This spotted Bull hath come and sat before the Mother and before The Father, mounting up to heaven.

verses.sa: अन्तश्चरति रोचनास्य प्राणादपानती। व्यख्यन् महिषो दिवम्॥
verses.tr: antaścarati rocanāsya prāṇādapānatī vyakhyan mahiṣo divam
verses.en: As expiration from his breath his radiance penetrates, within: The Bull shines out through all the sky.

verses.sa: त्रिंशद्धाम वि राजति वाक् पतङ्गाय धीयते। प्रति वस्तोरह द्युभिः॥
verses.tr: triṃśaddhāma vi rājati vāk pataṅgāya dhīyate prati vastoraha dyubhiḥ
verses.en: He rules supreme through thirty realms. Song is bestowed upon the Bird Throughout the days at break of morn.

verses.sa: अग्निर्ज्योतिर्ज्योतिरग्निः स्वाहा। सूर्यो ज्योतिर्ज्योतिः सूर्यः स्वाहा। अग्निर्वर्चो ज्योतिर्वर्चः स्वाहा। सूर्यो वर्चो ज्योतिर्वर्चः स्वाहा। ज्योतिः सूर्यः सूर्यो ज्योतिः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: agnirjyotirjyotiragniḥ svāhā sūryo jyotirjyotiḥ sūryaḥ svāhā agnirvarco jyotirvarcaḥ svāhā sūryo varco jyotirvarcaḥ svāhā jyotiḥ sūryaḥ sūryo jyotiḥ svāhā
verses.en: Agni is light, and light is Agni. Hail! Surya is light, and light is Surya. Hail! Agni is splendour, light is splendour. Hail! Surya is splendour, light is splendour. Hail! Light is Surya, Surya is light. Hail!

verses.sa: सजूर्देवेन सवित्रा सजू रात्र्येन्द्रवत्या। जुषाणो अग्निर्वेतु स्वाहा। सजूर्देवेन सवित्रा सजूरुषसेन्द्रवत्या। जुषाणः सूर्यो वेतु स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: sajūrdevena savitrā sajū rātryendravatyā juṣāṇo agnirvetu svāhā sajūrdevena savitrā sajūruṣasendravatyā juṣāṇaḥ sūryo vetu svāhā
verses.en: Accordant with bright Savitar and Night with Indra at her side, May Agni, being pleased, enjoy. All-hail!

verses.sa: उपप्रयन्तो अध्वरं मन्त्रं वोचेमाग्नये। आरे अस्मे च शृण्वते॥
verses.tr: upaprayanto adhvaraṃ mantraṃ vocemāgnaye āre asme ca śṛṇvate
verses.en: Approaching sacrifice, may we pronounce a text to Agni who Heareth us even when afar.

verses.sa: अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत्पतिः पृथिव्या अयम्। अपांरेतांसि जिन्वति॥
verses.tr: agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayam apāṃretāṃsi jinvati
verses.en: Agni is head and height of heaven, the Master of the earth is he: He quickeneth the waters' seed.

verses.sa: उभा वामिन्द्राग्नी आहुवध्या उभा राधसः सह मादयध्यै। उभा दाताराविषांरयीणामुभा वाजस्य सातये हुवे वाम्॥
verses.tr: ubhā vāmindrāgnī āhuvadhyā ubhā rādhasaḥ saha mādayadhyai ubhā dātārāviṣāṃrayīṇāmubhā vājasya sātaye huve vām
verses.en: You two will I invoke, O Indra-Agni, will please you both together, with oblation. Givers, you twain, of vigorous strength and riches, you twain do I invoke for gain of vigour.

verses.sa: अयं ते योनिरृत्वियो यतो जातो अरोचथाः। तं जानन्नग्न आरोहाथा नो वर्धया रयिम्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ te yonirṛtviyo yato jāto arocathāḥ taṃ jānannagna ārohāthā no vardhayā rayim
verses.en: This is thine ordered place of birth whence, sprung to life, thou shonest forth. Knowing this, Agni, rise thou up and cause our riches to increase.

verses.sa: अयमिह प्रथमो धायि धातृभिर्होता यजिष्ठो अध्वरेष्वीड्यः। यमप्नवानो भृगवो विरुरुचुर्वनेषु चित्रं विभ्वं विशेविशे॥
verses.tr: ayamiha prathamo dhāyi dhātṛbhirhotā yajiṣṭho adhvareṣvīḍyaḥ yamapnavāno bhṛgavo virurucurvaneṣu citraṃ vibhvaṃ viśeviśe
verses.en: Here by ordainers was this God appointed first Invoker, best at worship, to be praised at rites, Whom Apnavana and the Bhrigus caused to shine, bright coloured in the wood, spreading to every house.

verses.sa: अस्य प्रत्नामनु द्युतंशुक्रं दुदुह्रे अह्रयः। पयः सहस्रसामृषिम्॥
verses.tr: asya pratnāmanu dyutaṃśukraṃ duduhre ahrayaḥ payaḥ sahasrasāmṛṣim
verses.en: After his ancient splendour they, the bold, have drawn the bright milk from The Sage who wins a thousand gifts.

verses.sa: तनूपा अग्नेऽसि तन्वं मे पाह्यायुर्दा अग्ने स्यायुर्मे देहि वर्चोदा अग्नेऽसि वर्चो मे देहि। अग्ने यन्मे तन्वा ऊनं तन्म आपृण॥
verses.tr: tanūpā agne'si tanvaṃ me pāhyāyurdā agne syāyurme dehi varcodā agne'si varco me dehi agne yanme tanvā ūnaṃ tanma āpṛṇa
verses.en: Thou, Agni, art our bodies guard. Guard thou my body. Giver of life art thou, O> Agni. Give me life. Giver of splendour art thou, Agni. Give me splendour. All that is wanting in my body, Agni, supply for me.

verses.sa: इन्धानास्त्वा शतंहिमा द्युमन्तंसमिधीमहि। वयस्वन्तो वयस्कृत सहस्वन्तः सहस्कृतम्। अग्ने सपत्नदम्भनमदब्धासो अदाभ्यम्। चित्रावसो स्वस्ति ते पारमशीय॥
verses.tr: indhānāstvā śataṃhimā dyumantaṃsamidhīmahi vayasvanto vayaskṛta sahasvantaḥ sahaskṛtam agne sapatnadambhanamadabdhāso adābhyam citrāvaso svasti te pāramaśīya
verses.en: Enkindled we enkindle thee through hundred winters, thee the bright; We healthy, thee who givest health; we strong, thee author of our strength; We, never injured, Agni, thee uninjured injurer of foes. O rich in shining lights, may I in safety rich the end of thee.

verses.sa: सं त्वमग्ने सूर्यस्य वर्चसागथाः समृषीणां स्तुतेन। सं प्रियेण धाम्ना समहमायुषा सं वर्चसा सं प्रजया सं रायस्पोषेण ग्मिषीय॥
verses.tr: saṃ tvamagne sūryasya varcasāgathāḥ samṛṣīṇāṃ stutena saṃ priyeṇa dhāmnā samahamāyuṣā saṃ varcasā saṃ prajayā saṃ rāyaspoṣeṇa gmiṣīya
verses.en: Thou hast attained, O Agni, to the splendour of Surya, to the eulogy of Rishis, and to the habitation which thou lovest. May I attain to lengthened life, to splendour, to offspring and abundant store of riches.

verses.sa: अन्ध स्थान्धो वो भक्षीय मह स्थ महो वो भक्षीयोर्ज स्थोर्जं वो भक्षीय रायस्पोष स्थ रायस्पोषं वो भक्षीय॥
verses.tr: andha sthāndho vo bhakṣīya maha stha maho vo bhakṣīyorja sthorjaṃ vo bhakṣīya rāyaspoṣa stha rāyaspoṣaṃ vo bhakṣīya
verses.en: Ye are food, may I enjoy your food. Ye are might, may I enjoy your might. Ye are energy, may I enjoy your energy. Ye are abundant riches, may I enjoy your abundant riches.

verses.sa: रेवती रमध्वमस्मिन्योनावस्मिन् गोष्ठेऽस्मिंल्लोकेऽस्मिन्क्षये। इहैव स्त मापगात॥
verses.tr: revatī ramadhvamasminyonāvasmin goṣṭhe'smiṃlloke'sminkṣaye ihaiva sta māpagāta
verses.en: Sport, wealthy ones, in this abode, this fold, this spot, this dwelling-place. Remain just here, and go not hence.

verses.sa: संहितासि विश्वरूप्यूर्जा माविश गौपत्येन। उप त्वाग्ने दिवेदिवे दोषावस्तर्द्धिया वयम्। नमो भरन्त एमसि॥
verses.tr: saṃhitāsi viśvarūpyūrjā māviśa gaupatyena upa tvāgne divedive doṣāvastarddhiyā vayam namo bharanta emasi
verses.en: Composed art thou of every form and colour. With sap and ownership of kine approach me. To thee, dispeller of the night, Agni, day by day with prayer. Bringing thee reverence, we come;

verses.sa: राजन्तमध्वराणां गोपामृतस्य दीदिविम्। वर्धमानं स्वे दमे॥
verses.tr: rājantamadhvarāṇāṃ gopāmṛtasya dīdivim vardhamānaṃ sve dame
verses.en: Ruler of sacrifices, guard of Law eternal, radiant One, Increasing in thine own abode.

verses.sa: स नः पितेव सूनवेऽग्ने सूपायनो भव। सचस्वा नः स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ piteva sūnave'gne sūpāyano bhava sacasvā naḥ svastaye
verses.en: Be to us easy of approach, even as a father to his son: Agni, be with us for our weal.

verses.sa: अग्ने त्वं नो अन्तम उत त्राता शिवो भवा वरूथ्यः। वसुरग्निर्वसुश्रवा अच्छा नक्षि द्युमत्तमं रयिं दाः॥
verses.tr: agne tvaṃ no antama uta trātā śivo bhavā varūthyaḥ vasuragnirvasuśravā acchā nakṣi dyumattamaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ
verses.en: O Agni, be our nearest Friend; be thou a kind deliverer and gracious Friend. Excellent Agni, come thou nigh to us, and give us wealth most splendidly renowned.

verses.sa: तं त्वा शोचिष्ठ दीदिवः सुम्नाय नूनमीमहे सखिभ्यः। स नो बोधि श्रुधी हवमुरुष्या णो अधायतः समस्मात्॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā śociṣṭha dīdivaḥ sumnāya nūnamīmahe sakhibhyaḥ sa no bodhi śrudhī havamuruṣyā ṇo adhāyataḥ samasmāt
verses.en: To thee then, O most bright, O radiant God, we come with prayer for happiness for our friends. So hear us, listen to this call of ours, and keep us far from every evil man.

verses.sa: इड एह्यदित एहि काम्या एत। मयि वः कामधरणं भूयात्॥
verses.tr: iḍa ehyadita ehi kāmyā eta mayi vaḥ kāmadharaṇaṃ bhūyāt
verses.en: O Ida, come, O Aditi, come hither. Come hither, much desired! From you may I obtain my heart's desire.

verses.sa: सोमानं स्वरणं कृणुहि ब्रह्मणस्पते। कक्षीवन्तं य औशिजः॥
verses.tr: somānaṃ svaraṇaṃ kṛṇuhi brahmaṇaspate kakṣīvantaṃ ya auśijaḥ
verses.en: Brahmanaspati, make him who presses Soma glorious, Even Kakshivan Ausija.

verses.sa: यो रेवान्यो अमीवहा वसुवित्पुष्टिवर्द्धनः। स नः सिषक्तु यस्तुरः॥
verses.tr: yo revānyo amīvahā vasuvitpuṣṭivarddhanaḥ sa naḥ siṣaktu yasturaḥ
verses.en: The rich, the healer of disease, who findeth wealth, increaseth store, The prompt,—may he be with us still.

verses.sa: मा नः शंसो अररुषो धूर्तिः प्रणङ मर्त्यस्य। रक्षा णो ब्रह्मणस्पते॥
verses.tr: mā naḥ śaṃso araruṣo dhūrtiḥ praṇaṅa martyasya rakṣā ṇo brahmaṇaspate
verses.en: Let not the foeman's curse, let not a mortal's, treachery fall on us: Preserve us, Brahmanaspati!

verses.sa: महि त्रीणामवोऽस्तु द्युक्षं मित्रस्यार्यम्णः। दुराधर्षं वरुणस्य॥
verses.tr: mahi trīṇāmavo'stu dyukṣaṃ mitrasyāryamṇaḥ durādharṣaṃ varuṇasya
verses.en: Great, heavenly, unassailable, ours be the favour of the Three, Aryaman, Mitra, Varuna,

verses.sa: नहि तेषाममा चन नाध्वसु वारणेषु। ईशे रिपुरघशंसः॥
verses.tr: nahi teṣāmamā cana nādhvasu vāraṇeṣu īśe ripuraghaśaṃsaḥ
verses.en: For over them, neither at home nor upon pathways perilous, The evil-minded foe hath power.

verses.sa: ते हि पुत्रासो अदितेः प्र जीवसे मर्त्याय। ज्योतिर्यच्छन्त्यजस्रम्॥
verses.tr: te hi putrāso aditeḥ pra jīvase martyāya jyotiryacchantyajasram
verses.en: For they, the Sons of Aditi, bestow eternal light upon A mortal man that he may live.

verses.sa: कदा चन स्तरीरसि नेन्द्र सश्चसि दाशुषे। उपोपेन्नु मघवन् भूय इन्नु ते दानं देवस्य पृच्यते॥
verses.tr: kadā cana starīrasi nendra saścasi dāśuṣe upopennu maghavan bhūya innu te dānaṃ devasya pṛcyate
verses.en: Ne'er art thou fruitless, Indra, i ne'er dost thou forsake thy worshipper. But now, O Liberal Lord, thy bounty as a God is ever poured forth more and more.

verses.sa: तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि। धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्॥
verses.tr: tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt
verses.en: May we attain that excellent glory of Savitar the God: So may he stimulate our prayers.

verses.sa: परि ते दूडभो रथोऽस्माँ२ अश्नोतु विश्वतः। येन रक्षसि दाशुषः॥
verses.tr: pari te dūḍabho ratho'smāṃ2 aśnotu viśvataḥ yena rakṣasi dāśuṣaḥ
verses.en: May thine inviolable car wherewith thou guardest worship pers. Come near to us from every side.

verses.sa: भूर्भुवः स्वः सुप्रजाः प्रजाभिः स्यां सुवीरो वीरैः सुपोषः पोषैः। नर्य प्रजां मे पाहि शंस्य पशून्मे पाह्यथर्य पितुं मे पाहि॥
verses.tr: bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ suprajāḥ prajābhiḥ syāṃ suvīro vīraiḥ supoṣaḥ poṣaiḥ narya prajāṃ me pāhi śaṃsya paśūnme pāhyatharya pituṃ me pāhi
verses.en: Earth! Ether! Sky! May I be rich in offspring, well manned with men and opulent with riches. Friendly to men! Do thou protect my offspring. Worthy of praise! Do thou protect my cattle. O pointed One, protect the food that feeds me.

verses.sa: आ गन्म विश्ववेदसमस्मभ्यं वसुवित्तमम्। अग्ने सम्राडभि द्युम्नमभि सह आ यच्छस्व॥
verses.tr: ā ganma viśvavedasamasmabhyaṃ vasuvittamam agne samrāḍabhi dyumnamabhi saha ā yacchasva
verses.en: We have approached the Omniscient, best finder-out of wealth for us. Splendour and strength bestow on us, O Agni, thou Imperial Lord.

verses.sa: अयमग्निर्गृहपतिर्गार्हपत्यः प्रजाया वसुवित्तमः। अग्ने गृहपतेऽभि द्युम्नमभि सह आ यच्छस्व॥
verses.tr: ayamagnirgṛhapatirgārhapatyaḥ prajāyā vasuvittamaḥ agne gṛhapate'bhi dyumnamabhi saha ā yacchasva
verses.en: Lord of the Home, this Agni Garhapatya is best at finding riches for our children. Splendour and strength bestow on us, O Agni, Master of the Home.

verses.sa: अयमग्निः पुरीष्यो रयिमान् पुष्टिवर्धनः। अग्ने पुरीष्याभि द्युम्नमभि सह आ यच्छस्व॥
verses.tr: ayamagniḥ purīṣyo rayimān puṣṭivardhanaḥ agne purīṣyābhi dyumnamabhi saha ā yacchasva
verses.en: Rich, furtherer of plenty is this Agni, Master of the Herd. Splendour and strength bestow on us, O Agni, Master of the Herd.

verses.sa: गृहा मा बिभीत मा वेपध्वमूर्जं बिभ्रत एमसि। ऊर्जं बिभ्रद्वः सुमनाः सुमेधा गृहानैमि मनसा मोदमानः॥
verses.tr: gṛhā mā bibhīta mā vepadhvamūrjaṃ bibhrata emasi ūrjaṃ bibhradvaḥ sumanāḥ sumedhā gṛhānaimi manasā modamānaḥ
verses.en: Fear not, nor tremble thou, O House. To thee who bearest strength we come. I, bearing strength, intelligent and happy, come to thee. House, rejoicing in my spirit.

verses.sa: येषामध्येति प्रवसन्येषु सौमनसो बहुः। गृहानुपह्वयामहे ते नो जानन्तु जानतः॥
verses.tr: yeṣāmadhyeti pravasanyeṣu saumanaso bahuḥ gṛhānupahvayāmahe te no jānantu jānataḥ
verses.en: The home on which the wanderer thinks, where cheerfulness and joy abound—We call the Home to welcome us. May it know us who know it well.

verses.sa: उपहूता इह गाव उपहूता अजावयः। अथो अन्नस्य कीलाल उपहूतो गृहेषु नः। क्षेमाय वः शान्त्यै प्रपद्ये शिवं शग्मं शंयोः शंयोः॥
verses.tr: upahūtā iha gāva upahūtā ajāvayaḥ atho annasya kīlāla upahūto gṛheṣu naḥ kṣemāya vaḥ śāntyai prapadye śivaṃ śagmaṃ śaṃyoḥ śaṃyoḥ
verses.en: Here have the cows been called to us, the goats and sheep have been called near, And in our home we have addressed the meath that sweeteneth our food. I come to thee for safety and for quiet. May joy be ours, felicity, and blessing.

verses.sa: प्रघासिनो हवामहे मरुतश्च रिशादसः। करम्भेण सजोषसः॥
verses.tr: praghāsino havāmahe marutaśca riśādasaḥ karambheṇa sajoṣasaḥ
verses.en: We invocate the Maruts, the voracious, eaters of their foes, Delighting in their mess of meal.

verses.sa: यद्ग्रामे यदरण्ये यत्सभायां यदिन्द्रिये। यदेनश्चकृमा वयमिदं तदवयजामहे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yadgrāme yadaraṇye yatsabhāyāṃ yadindriye yadenaścakṛmā vayamidaṃ tadavayajāmahe svāhā
verses.en: We expiate by sacrifice each sinful act that we have done, Whether in village or the wild, in company or corporeal sense. Svadha!

verses.sa: मो षू ण इन्द्रात्र पृत्सु देवैरस्ति हि ष्मा ते शुष्मिन्नवयाः। महश्चिद्यस्य मीढुषो यव्या हविष्मतो मरुतो वन्दते गीः॥
verses.tr: mo ṣū ṇa indrātra pṛtsu devairasti hi ṣmā te śuṣminnavayāḥ mahaścidyasya mīḍhuṣo yavyā haviṣmato maruto vandate gīḥ
verses.en: Let us not here contend with Gods, O Indra, for. Fierce One! here is thine own sacred portion, Thine, Mighty One, whose friends, the bounteous Maruts, his song who pours oblation, streamlike, honours.

verses.sa: अक्रन् कर्म कर्मकृतः सह वाचा मयोभुवा। देवेभ्यः कर्म कृत्वास्तं प्रेत सचाभुवः॥
verses.tr: akran karma karmakṛtaḥ saha vācā mayobhuvā devebhyaḥ karma kṛtvāstaṃ preta sacābhuvaḥ
verses.en: The skilful workers have performed their work with voice that gives delight. Having performed the work for Gods, go, ye companions, to your home.

verses.sa: अवभृथ निचुम्पुण निचेरुरसि निचुम्पुणः। अव देवैर्देवकृतमेनोऽयासिषमव मर्त्यैर्मर्त्यकृतं पुरुराव्णो देव रिषस्पाहि॥
verses.tr: avabhṛtha nicumpuṇa nicerurasi nicumpuṇaḥ ava devairdevakṛtameno'yāsiṣamava martyairmartyakṛtaṃ pururāvṇo deva riṣaspāhi
verses.en: O ever-moving Cleansing Bath, thou movest gliding on thy way. With Gods may I wash out the sin that I have sinned against the Gods, with men the sin against mankind. Preserve me safe from injury, O God, from him who loudly roars.

verses.sa: पूर्णा दर्वि परा पत सुपूर्णा पुनरा पत। वस्नेव विक्रीणावहा इषमूर्जं शतक्रतो॥
verses.tr: pūrṇā darvi parā pata supūrṇā punarā pata vasneva vikrīṇāvahā iṣamūrjaṃ śatakrato
verses.en: Full, fly away, O spoon, and filled completely fly thou back to us. O Satakratu, let us twain barter, like goods, our food and strength.

verses.sa: देहि मे ददामि ते नि मे धेहि नि त दधे। निहारं च हरासि मे निहारं नि हराणि ते स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: dehi me dadāmi te ni me dhehi ni ta dadhe nihāraṃ ca harāsi me nihāraṃ ni harāṇi te svāhā
verses.en: Give me, I give thee gifts: bestow on me, and I bestow on thee. To me present thy merchandise, and I to thee will give my wares.

verses.sa: अक्षन्नमीमदन्त ह्यव प्रिया अधूषत। अस्तोषत स्वभानवो विप्रा निविष्ठया मती योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी॥
verses.tr: akṣannamīmadanta hyava priyā adhūṣata astoṣata svabhānavo viprā niviṣṭhayā matī yojā nvindra te harī
verses.en: Well have they eaten and regaled; the friends have risen and passed away. The sages, luminous in themselves, have praised thee with their latest hymn. Now, Indra, yoke thy two Bay Steeds.

verses.sa: सुसन्दृशं त्वा वयं मघवन्वन्दिषीमहि। प्र नूनं पूर्णबन्धुर स्तुतो यासि वशाँ२ अनु योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी॥
verses.tr: susandṛśaṃ tvā vayaṃ maghavanvandiṣīmahi pra nūnaṃ pūrṇabandhura stuto yāsi vaśāṃ2 anu yojā nvindra te harī
verses.en: Thee will we reverence, thee, O Lord of Bounty, who art fair to see. Thus praised, according to our wish come now with richly-laden car. Now, Indra, yoke thy two Bay Steeds.

verses.sa: मनो न्वाह्वामहे नाराशंसेन स्तोमेन। पितॄणां च मन्मभिः॥
verses.tr: mano nvāhvāmahe nārāśaṃsena stomena pitṝṇāṃ ca manmabhiḥ
verses.en: We call the spirit hither with a hero-celebrating strain, Yea, with the Fathers' holy hymns.

verses.sa: आ न एतु मनः पुनः क्रत्वे दक्षाय जीवसे। ज्योक् च सूर्यं दृशे॥
verses.tr: ā na etu manaḥ punaḥ kratve dakṣāya jīvase jyok ca sūryaṃ dṛśe
verses.en: The spirit comes to us again for wisdom, energy, and life, That we may long behold the Sun.

verses.sa: पुनर्नः पितरो मनो ददातु दैव्यो जनः। जीवं व्रातं सचेमहि॥
verses.tr: punarnaḥ pitaro mano dadātu daivyo janaḥ jīvaṃ vrātaṃ sacemahi
verses.en: O Fathers, may the Heavenly Folk give us the spirit once again. That we may be with those who live.

verses.sa: वयं सोम व्रते तव मनस्तनूषु बिभ्रतः। प्रजावन्तः सचेमहि॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ soma vrate tava manastanūṣu bibhrataḥ prajāvantaḥ sacemahi
verses.en: O Soma, with the spirit still within us, blest with progeny, May we be busied in thy law,

verses.sa: एष ते रुद्र भागः सह स्वस्राम्बिकया तं जुषस्व स्वाहैष ते रुद्र भाग आखुस्ते पशुः॥
verses.tr: eṣa te rudra bhāgaḥ saha svasrāmbikayā taṃ juṣasva svāhaiṣa te rudra bhāga ākhuste paśuḥ
verses.en: O Rudra, this is thine allotted portion. With Ambika thy sister kindly take it. This, Rudra, is thy share, the rat thy victim.

verses.sa: अव रुद्रमदीमह्यव देवं त्र्यम्बकम्। यथा नो वस्यसस्करद्यथा नः श्रेयसस्करद्यथा नो व्यवसाययात्॥
verses.tr: ava rudramadīmahyava devaṃ tryambakam yathā no vasyasaskaradyathā naḥ śreyasaskaradyathā no vyavasāyayāt
verses.en: We have contented Rudra, yea, put off Tryambaka the God, That he may make us wealthier, may make us yet more prosperous, may make us vigorous to act.

verses.sa: भेषजमसि भेषजं गवेऽश्वाय पुरुषाय भेषजम्। सुखं मेषाय मेष्यै॥
verses.tr: bheṣajamasi bheṣajaṃ gave'śvāya puruṣāya bheṣajam sukhaṃ meṣāya meṣyai
verses.en: Thou art a healing medicine, a balm for cow and horse and man, a happiness to ram and ewe.

verses.sa: त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम्। उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात्। त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पतिवेदनम्। उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनादितो मुक्षीय मामुतः॥
verses.tr: tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam urvārukamiva bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ pativedanam urvārukamiva bandhanādito mukṣīya māmutaḥ
verses.en: Tryambaka we worship, sweet augmenter of prosperity. As from its stem a cucumber, may I be freed from bonds of death, not reft of immortality. We worship him, Tryambaka, the husband-finder, sweet to smell. As from its stem a cucumber, hence and not thence may I be loosed.

verses.sa: एतत्ते रुद्रावसं तेन परो मूजवतोऽतीहि। अवततधन्वा पिनाकावसः कृत्तिवासा अहिंसन्नः शिवोऽतीहि॥
verses.tr: etatte rudrāvasaṃ tena paro mūjavato'tīhi avatatadhanvā pinākāvasaḥ kṛttivāsā ahiṃsannaḥ śivo'tīhi
verses.en: This, Rudra, is thy food: with this depart beyond the With bow unstrung, with muffled staff, clothed in a garment made of skin, gracious, not harming us, depart.

verses.sa: त्र्यायुषं जमदग्नेः कश्यपस्य त्र्यायुषम्। यद्देवेषु त्र्यायुषं तन्नो अस्तु त्र्यायुषम्॥
verses.tr: tryāyuṣaṃ jamadagneḥ kaśyapasya tryāyuṣam yaddeveṣu tryāyuṣaṃ tanno astu tryāyuṣam
verses.en: May Jamadagni's triple life, the triple life of Kasyapa, The triple life of Deities—may that same triple life be ours.

verses.sa: शिवो नामासि स्वधितिस्ते पिता नमस्ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीः। नि वर्तयाम्यायुषेऽन्नाद्याय प्रजननाय रायस्पोषाय सुप्रजास्त्वाय सुवीर्याय॥
verses.tr: śivo nāmāsi svadhitiste pitā namaste astu mā mā hiṃsīḥ ni vartayāmyāyuṣe'nnādyāya prajananāya rāyaspoṣāya suprajāstvāya suvīryāya
verses.en: Gracious, thy name; the thunder is thy father. Obeisance be to thee: forbear to harm me. I shave thee for long life, for food to feed thee, for progeny, for riches in abundance, for noble children, for heroic vigour.
